title: Routines
subtitle: Recurring work definitions that materialize into auditable execution issues.
selectCompany: Select a company to view routines.
emptyState: No routines yet. Use Create routine to define the first recurring workflow.
routineCreatedBody: Add the first trigger to turn it into a live workflow.
failedToUpdateBody: Paperclip could not update the routine.
routineRunFailedBody: Paperclip could not start the routine run.
failedToSaveBody: Paperclip could not save the routine.
newRoutineHint: Define the recurring work first. Trigger setup comes next on the detail page.
afterCreation: After creation, Paperclip takes you straight to trigger setup for schedules, webhooks, or internal runs.
advancedDeliveryHint: Keep policy controls secondary to the work definition.
concurrencyCoalesceIfActive: If a run is already active, keep just one follow-up run queued.
concurrencyAlwaysEnqueue: Queue every trigger occurrence, even if the routine is already running.
concurrencySkipIfActive: Drop new trigger occurrences while a run is still active.
catchUpSkipMissed: Ignore windows that were missed while the scheduler or routine was paused.
catchUpEnqueueMissedWithCap: Catch up missed schedule windows in capped batches after recovery.
concurrencyCoalesceIfActiveDetail: Keep one follow-up run queued while an active run is still working.
concurrencyAlwaysEnqueueDetail: Queue every trigger occurrence, even if several runs stack up.
concurrencySkipIfActiveDetail: Drop overlapping trigger occurrences while the routine is already active.
catchUpSkipMissedDetail: Ignore schedule windows that were missed while the routine or scheduler was paused.
catchUpEnqueueMissedWithCapDetail: Catch up missed schedule windows in capped batches after recovery.
saveSecretNow: Save this now. Paperclip will not show the secret value again.
label: Label
signingModeBearer: Expect a shared bearer token in the Authorization header.
signingModeHmac: Expect an HMAC SHA-256 signature over the request using the shared secret.
triggerSavedBody: The routine cadence update was saved.
failedToAddTriggerBody: Paperclip could not create the trigger.
failedToUpdateTriggerBody: Paperclip could not update the trigger.
failedToDeleteTriggerBody: Paperclip could not delete the trigger.
failedToRotateBody: Paperclip could not rotate the webhook secret.
runRoutineDialogDescription: Fill in the routine variables before starting the execution issue.
chooseWorkspaceBefore: Choose an existing workspace before running.
variablesDetectedHint: Detected from `{{name}}` placeholders in the routine instructions.
variablesPlaceholderHint: Use `{{variable_name}}` placeholders in the instructions to prompt for inputs when the routine runs.
promptBeforeRun: Prompt the user for this value before each manual run.
cronFieldsHelp: Five fields: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week
